parts.label: (a)
parts.text: State what is meant by work done.

parts.label: (b)
parts.text: Use the answer to (a) to determine the SI base units of power.

parts.label: (c)
parts.part_stem:
The maximum useful output power $P$ of a car travelling on a horizontal road is given by $$P = v^3b$$ where $v$ is the maximum speed of the car and $b$ is a constant.

For the car,

$P = 84\ \text{kW} \pm 5\%$
and $b = 0.56 \pm 7\%$ in SI units.

parts.label: (c)(ii)
parts.text: Determine the absolute uncertainty in the value of $v$.
